title: auth: is_dev_mode() ignores client_certs and trusted_issuers
description:
## Problem
config.rs is_dev_mode() only checks users.is_empty() && credential_file.is_none(). If an operator configures client_certs or trusted_issuers (cert-based auth) but leaves users empty, is_dev_mode() returns true, which bypasses auth entirely.

## Security impact
An operator deploying cert-based-only authentication silently gets an open server.

## Fix
is_dev_mode() must return true only when ALL auth mechanisms are unconfigured: users empty, credential_file None, client_certs empty, trusted_issuers empty.

## Acceptance criteria
- is_dev_mode() returns false when client_certs is non-empty
- is_dev_mode() returns false when trusted_issuers is non-empty
- Unit tests cover all four combinations
